items.prompt:
Photorealistic ultra-wide-angle selfie-style portrait with dynamic motion blur, direct flash film photography style, heavy film grain, high contrast flash lighting, Douyin hot-girl diary aesthetic, casual daily snapshot vibe, not overly staged, spontaneous and slightly imperfect framing. Medium-close composition from a slightly low upward angle, dynamic handheld selfie perspective, strong sense of movement.

A beautiful young adult East Asian woman with waist-length deep brown wavy hair slightly messy from the night wind, doll-like cute facial features, cool fair skin, delicate oval face with a slightly pointed chin. Translucent natural base makeup, soft smoky eyes, glossy deep red lips. She has a slim figure, small bust, pale luminous skin.

Her expression is lazily seductive: half-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted as if she just stopped talking, a faint knowing smile, looking straight into the camera with a soft, almost bored allure. Her head is tilted back a little, one shoulder dropped, body leaning slightly away from the camera. Hair partially covers one eye.

She wears an oversized pink sleeveless cropped tank that hangs loosely, revealing a thin strip of midriff, black ultra-short shorts, and a black multi-pocket underarm bag slung casually. Round hoop earrings and a large black dial watch.

Background: quiet urban street at night under warm streetlights mixed with harsh direct flash, red brick wall, large trees casting leaf shadows, distant blurred city lights. Warm brown-gray-black palette, dramatic flash highlights, deep shadows, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, natural skin texture with visible pores, realistic phone-camera texture, heavy film grain, candid nightlife atmosphere, imperfect composition, 8K detail.
